boundaryNotes: La Esperanza is assigned to es-cartagena because Cartagena municipal material places La Esperanza in the Diputación de Alumbres.

Calle Mayor, Casas del Sindicato, El Punto and the Tanatorio stop cluster are assigned to es-la-union using accepted La Unión core identities, official La Unión locality evidence and stop coordinates.
Camping Los Delfines is assigned to es-mazarron; Mazarrón municipal records explicitly place that camping in the municipality even though Cartagena directories may also list it as a nearby service.
Isla Plana, La Azohía, Perín, Tallante and Cuesta Blanca are assigned to es-cartagena from Cartagena municipal/diputación evidence.

transformations.description: Copies all 23 published Line 30/41/42A source sections independently; no route rediscovery, reverse inference or branch synthesis.
Copies 12 accepted Cartagena StopNode/StopPlace identities exactly from prior accepted scenarios.
Creates 93 absent singleton identities using official numeric stop codes and Grade C operator-linked coordinates.

warnings: Line 30 source topology is asymmetric. No missing mirror/reverse variant is invented.
Public route code 42A is preserved although the official source URL slug is /linea/42.
The project radial family is a packaging classification, not a claim that every included service is geographically radial.
StopNode.sourceReferences are empty for new identities because no genuine OpenStreetMap node/way was reconciled.
No authoritative application parser or repository test suite was available; Level 7 is not claimed.
